_notes: Part 2 of stage 4b's race ships (docs/plans/stage-4b.md, item 3): utwig, mycon, androsyn, mmrnmhrm, chenjesu, slylandr, urquan, blackurq, each with its own code (src/uqm/ships/RACE/RACE.c: init_RACE's RACE_DESC, its preprocess, postprocess, weapon and intelligence functions), in UQM 0.8.0's own battle engine, recorded by the program battle.json, battle-ships.json and battle-ai.json are (tools/extract/golden/battle.c; see their notes for the engine, the sheets, the masks, the flagship, the AI and the frames), as an encounter runs a battle. Each battle is a program run of its own, so nothing a ship's code keeps between battles carries over (pkunk.c's last insult needn't: init_pkunk resets it whenever a Pkunk is made).

Each race ship has two battles: RACE-keys, the race ship (side 1) flown by keys against the flagship (side 0, keys; a new game's with two more crew pods, firing its gun in bursts): it flies at the flagship and in turn presses its weapon in pulses, its special, then both at once, each for 40 frames (the Slylandro flies at an asteroid while it presses its special, which harvests them); and RACE-ai, the race ship flown by UQM's AI (awesome, the story's enemy's: its own intelligence_func on cyborg.c) against the flagship flown by the AI (sis_intelligence, UQM's Cyborg option; a blaster and a tracking system too). Each takes the first seed (a thousand apart) in which its ship's weapon and special each have an effect (the weapon pressed without the special, whose the Orz's both are, its marines; the special with or without the weapon): the battle with those presses taken away (the keys' or the AI's, battle.c's mask) differs, with the same input until it does (the ship's status flags' weapon and special bits aside, being the presses themselves, and LOW_ON_ENERGY, a press without the energy); never before frame 2 (frame 1's input comes as the ship warps in). uses: the first frame each has one. The Shofixti (recruited) has a second ship (fleet), as its self-destruct ends the first; pkunk-rebirth is a Pkunk of 2 crew by keys, the first seed in which it dies and is reborn (new_pkunk). Checked when recorded: recorded twice, they're the same, and each shows what it's for.

input: as battle-ai.json's, and a race ship is kind race: ship (data/ships.json's id) and crew (its STARSHIP's crew_level, which spawn_ship holds its RACE_DESC's crew to, at most its max_crew); shofixti_recruited: SHOFIXTI_RECRUITED set (without it an encounter's Shofixti is Tanaka's damaged scout, init_shofixti). The race ship's sheets are its RACE_DESC's as load_ship loads them (load_animation: a size without its own is the size before's), and its status icons and captain's window: the Shofixti's self-destruct counts the captain window's frames (captain_control.special, set by DrawCaptainsWindow), and the VUX's limpets test the hit ship's icons' frame 1 (ModifySilhouette, which draws random numbers to place them). GetSoundCount of the Pkunk's sounds is the content's (14): pkunk_postprocess draws insults until one differs from the last.

uses: {weapon, special}, the frame in which each first has an effect (not in pkunk-rebirth). inputs, frames, crew_enlisted, bomb_carrier, crew_floating and freed: as battle-ai.json's. The frames' draws name UQM's functions, the ships' own static ones among them.
